turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, good to have you here. How are you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My phone has gotten painfully slow and I'm not sure how to fix it.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me get through all the options before you weigh in.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I could do a full factory reset and set everything up again from scratch.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or pay a shop to swap the battery, since I've heard old batteries slow phones down.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Another idea is just deleting a ton of apps and photos to free up space.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or give up and buy a new one, which I really don't want to do.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's all I've got. Which would you choose?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Start with clearing space, it's free and often helps right away. If it's still sluggish, a battery swap is cheap compared to a new phone, and a factory reset is the deep clean if nothing else works.
